comparison.objective: Commission a damper, versus rotate and center a guarded blank using two push tools.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate requires recessed hex-tool use, bounded torque, fine collar manipulation, and iterative tests; record requires bimanual indirect pushing while keeping both grippers outside a guard.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires two safe bounded impact cycles. Record requires target angular alignment and centering with zero score for guard entry; numeric angle and centering tolerances are not stated.
comparison.reason: Shared tool-mediated rotation is generic. The record tests coordinated guarded pushing and centering, while the candidate tests locking and empirical dynamic tuning.
